rootCauses: Remote smoke checked asset parity and synthetic idempotence but did not validate cross-module semantic equality in the human browser.
The previous composer appended unmatched protected profiles to the operational HR shopper list, creating split identities without a technical crosswalk.
Dashboard, phase flow, finance and shopper portal retained independent literal-state interpretations instead of one canonicalFacets authority.
The watcher restored DOM select values separately from CX.data.currentPeriodId and captured the wrong scroll containers, producing period-model divergence and visible jumps.
Profile completeness trusted stored flags instead of actual minimum contact and credential fields.
Mis Visitas selected at most one visit per literal state and treated only liquidated/cancelled as history.
Canonical finance snapshots and payment history were not projected consistently into Movimientos, Liquidaciones and Beneficios.
